{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check if 'order_id' has a pattern indicating test orders (e.g., 'TEST' in ID)
test_order_ids = df[df['order_id'].str.contains('TEST', na=False)]
print(f'Number of order IDs containing "TEST": {len(test_order_ids)}')

# Check if any order_id starts with 'TEST'
test_order_ids_start = df[df['order_id'].str.startswith('TEST', na=False)]
print(f'Number of order IDs starting with "TEST": {len(test_order_ids_start)}')"}
